belseco_master.title: Belseco: Upfit Master
belseco_master.desc: Master power for every Belseco upfit system. Off kills lights, siren and equipment.

belseco_all_off.title: Belseco: All Systems Off
belseco_all_off.desc: Panic-off: lightbar, siren, advisor, arrow board and scene lighting.

belseco_lightbar_cycle.title: Belseco: Lightbar Level
belseco_lightbar_cycle.desc: Cycle the lightbar: off, level 1 cruise, level 2 warning, level 3 lane blocking.

belseco_lightbar_toggle.title: Belseco: Lightbar On/Off
belseco_lightbar_toggle.desc: Single-press toggle straight to level 2 and back to off.

belseco_advisor_cycle.title: Belseco: Traffic Advisor
belseco_advisor_cycle.desc: Cycle the rear traffic advisor: off, left, right, split, wig-wag.

belseco_siren_toggle.title: Belseco: Siren On/Off
belseco_siren_toggle.desc: Toggle the siren using the last selected tone.

belseco_siren_cycle.title: Belseco: Siren Tone
belseco_siren_cycle.desc: Step through wail, yelp, phaser and hi-lo.

belseco_airhorn.title: Belseco: Air Horn
belseco_airhorn.desc: Momentary air horn, ducks the siren tone while held.

belseco_board_cycle.title: Belseco: Arrow Board Display
belseco_board_cycle.desc: Cycle arrow board: off, four corner, caution bar, left, right, double, flashing.

belseco_board_deploy.title: Belseco: Arrow Board Mast
belseco_board_deploy.desc: Raise or stow the arrow board mast. Lamps only light once it is up.

belseco_scene_package.title: Belseco: Scene Lighting Package
belseco_scene_package.desc: All scene floods, alley lights, ground lights and beacons at once.
belseco_scene_package.onDown: if belsecoAction then belsecoAction('aux.scene', true) end

belseco_scene_off.title: Belseco: Auxiliary Lighting Off
belseco_scene_off.desc: Turn off every auxiliary fixture, leaving the lightbar running.

belseco_preset_responding.title: Belseco Preset: Responding
belseco_preset_responding.desc: Level 2 lightbar, wail, wig-wags and take-downs.

belseco_preset_onscene.title: Belseco Preset: On Scene
belseco_preset_onscene.desc: Level 3 lightbar, siren off, full scene lighting package.

belseco_preset_block_left.title: Belseco Preset: Lane Block Merge Left
belseco_preset_block_left.desc: Advisor and arrow board pushing traffic to the left, scene lighting up.

belseco_preset_block_right.title: Belseco Preset: Lane Block Merge Right
belseco_preset_block_right.desc: Advisor and arrow board pushing traffic to the right, scene lighting up.
